function: no_learning: RIS phase shifts and power allocation for energy efficiency are found by alternating optimization with a cross-entropy sampling optimizer, Dinkelbach's algorithm and ZF precoding (p. 2-3).
notes: Excluded as no_learning (p. 3). The "probability learning-based algorithm" is the cross-entropy optimization method, run per channel realization with no training data or trained parameters. p. 3: "The CEO framework is an iterative method that employs tilting parameters to guide a probabilistic sampling process towards optimal solutions". Power allocation uses Dinkelbach's algorithm (p. 3) and precoding is closed-form ZF (p. 2); no neural network or trained model appears anywhere.
